purpose: Canonical research policy for T-day screening, deep-research risk bands, validation and chart markers.

eligibility.historyGate: SMA200 must be available for market-wide RED/YELLOW eligibility

validation.calibrationMethod: separate chronological calibration diagnostics; final user-facing probability uses regularized chronological Platt meta-calibration and is withheld unless its OOS gate passes

corporateActionGuard.treatment: flag and neutralize only for model-return/event-label construction; preserve raw prices for investor chart
corporateActionGuard.note: Heuristic guard only. Official adjusted-price/corporate-action data remain preferable.

semantics.deepRiskIndex: 0-100 historical risk percentile blended with a limited current-context overlay
semantics.calibratedCrashProbability: regularized Platt 20-session crash estimate shown only when chronological out-of-sample probability calibration beats the historical base-rate benchmark and event-depth gates pass
semantics.alertMeaning: risk-review triage; not a buy/sell signal
